scenes.say: Should you wait for a cataract to ripen before surgery? Let's bust three common myths.

scenes.en: The clear lens inside your eye slowly turns cloudy, mostly with age
scenes.ta: கண்ணின் உள்ளே உள்ள லென்ஸ் மெல்ல மங்கலாகிறது
scenes.say: Inside your eye is a clear lens that focuses light. With age, it slowly turns cloudy, like a foggy window.

scenes.en: Fact: Surgery can be done once it troubles daily life
scenes.ta: உண்மை: அன்றாட வேலை பாதித்தால் அறுவை சிகிச்சை செய்யலாம்
scenes.say: Myth one. You must wait till it ripens. Fact. There's no need to wait. Surgery can be done once blurry vision troubles daily life. Waiting too long can make it harder.

scenes.en: Fact: No drops or diet can remove a cataract. Only surgery can.
scenes.say: Myth two. Eye drops can dissolve a cataract. Fact. No drops or diet can remove a cataract. Only surgery can.

scenes.en: Fact: Most people return to light daily activities within a few days
scenes.say: Myth three. You need weeks of bed rest. Fact. Most people return to light daily activities within a few days. Just follow your surgeon's advice.

scenes.en: WHO says cataract is a leading cause of blindness worldwide, yet it is treatable
scenes.ta: உலகில் பார்வை இழப்புக்கு முக்கிய காரணம் கண்புரை
scenes.say: Did you know? The World Health Organization says cataract is a leading cause of blindness worldwide. Yet this vision loss can usually be treated.

scenes.en: Sudden vision loss, eye pain or redness: see an eye specialist the same day
scenes.ta: திடீர் பார்வை இழப்பு, வலி: உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if you have sudden vision loss, eye pain, or redness.

scenes.en: Book an eye test and know for sure
scenes.say: Blurry vision, or glare at night? Book an eye test and know for sure.
